verdict.rationale: Kong ships official CLIs. decK is documented as a command-line tool for APIOps that automates the API lifecycle and manages Konnect and Kong Gateway, and kongctl has its own docs page and an AI Gateway conversion extension. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or agent workflow integration, depth on kongctl beyond a page title and one migration use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
